evidence: Refactors wallet internals by moving code between src/wallet/ files.
rationale: Extracts over 800 lines of legacy migration routines from the 4,500-line `wallet/wallet.cpp` into dedicated migration files to improve modularity and maintainability. The author notes that `wallet/wallet.cpp` is 'more than 4500 lines long currently and this patch is an attempt to shortern it by around 800 lines by extracting out the wallet migration code'.
